'''Huang Benli''' ({{zh|s=黄本立}}; 21 September 1925 – 29 June 2025) was a Chinese spectral chemist who was a professor at [[Xiamen University]], and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. He was a member of the Chinese Democratic League.<ref>{{cite news |author1=Zhong Yuhao ({{lang|zh|钟煜豪}}) |url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_31067714 |script-title=zh:著名光谱学家、分析化学家和教育家黄本立院士辞世 |work=thepaper.cn |date=2025-06-30 |access-date=2025-07-04 |language=zh}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Huang was born in [[British Hong Kong]], on 21 September 1925, while his [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] is in [[Xinhui, Jiangmen|Xinhui County]] (now Xinhui, [[Jiangmen]]), [[Guangdong]].<ref name="ab">{{cite news |author1=She Zheng ({{lang|zh|佘峥}}) |url=https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20250701A02BU300 |script-title=zh:厦门大学发布讣告：黄本立院士逝世！他的一生只为国家所需 |work=qq.com |date=2025-07-01 |access-date=2025-07-04 |language=zh}}</ref> In 1945, he was accepted to the [[Lingnan University]]，where he majored in the Physics Department.<ref name="ab"/>

After University in 1950, Huang was assigned to the Changchun Northeast Science Research Institute (now Changchun Institute of Applied Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences), where he successively worked as technician in 1950, assistant researcher in 1956, deputy researcher in 1978, and researcher in 1982.<ref name="ab"/> In 1986, he was recruited as a professor at [[Xiamen University]].<ref name="ab"/>

On 29 June 2025, Huang died in [[Xiamen]], [[Fujian]], at the age of 99.<ref name="ab"/><ref>{{cite news |url=https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20250702A060RL00 |script-title=zh:送别黄本立院士，他曾争取到国际光谱会议首次在中国举办 |work=qq.com |date=2025-07-02 |access-date=2025-07-04 |language=zh}}</ref>

== Honours and awards ==
* 1985 State Science and Technology Progress Award (Third Class) for the Research on Environmental Pollution Analysis Methods and Development of Standard Samples<ref name="ab"/>
* November 1993 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref name="ab"/>
